title: Reference-Testing Cancellation Handling Fee: Booking Conditions and the Starting Amount
content:
The reference-testing cancellation handling fee is the fee booked when a patient cancels their own Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class before testing starts.

**When it is booked.** The reference-testing cancellation handling fee is booked only for an accession cancelled from *accessioned* or *testing hold*. An accession cancelled from *received* or *information hold* is booked no handling fee.

| Status of the reference-testing accession at cancellation | Handling fee |
|---|---|
| Received | none (0.00) |
| Information hold | none (0.00) |
| Accessioned | the starting amount |
| Testing hold | the starting amount |

**The fee.** The reference-testing cancellation handling fee is the **starting amount**, which is the class's cancellation handling fee after accessioning. It is booked as a single charge line with the reason *cancellation handling fee*, is never below zero, and is rounded to two decimal places only at the end.

**Points of judgement.**

- *An accession cancelled the day its specimen was accessioned.* The status is accessioned, so a handling fee is booked.
- *An accession cancelled while on information hold, before any specimen was taken.* No handling fee is booked.
